description: This file defines utility enums and functions related to processing command-line environment invocation and execution unlinking in a Swift project. It provides mechanisms for parsing, unwrapping, and analyzing command tokens, particularly focusing on environment variable assignments, command flags, and wrapper resolution logic.

classes.name: ExecEnvInvocationUnwrapper
classes.description: Provides static methods and constants for unwrapping and analyzing shell command invocations to resolve wrappers and environment variable settings.

methods.name: basenameLower
methods.description: Converts a file path token to a lowercase basename, normalizing slashes.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Unwraps command tokens from wrappers, returning the core command.

methods.name: unwrapWithMetadata
methods.description: Unwraps command tokens, providing metadata such as whether the command uses modifiers.

methods.name: isEnvAssignment
methods.description: Checks if a token is an environment variable assignment.

methods.name: unwrapDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Recursively unwraps command tokens from env wrappers used for resolution.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentEnvInvocation
methods.description: Unwraps transparent env invocation tokens, returning the command after env variables.

methods.name: unwrapTransparentDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Recursively unwraps transparent env wrappers for command resolution.
